units.source_text: 筑前守挥泪辞归，将公子近况禀复父亲。

en.t: The Governor of Chikuzen took his leave in tears and returned home, reporting the young lord's recent circumstances to his father.

units.source_text: 太宰大弍以及来此迎接的诸人听了他的话，都认为遗憾，一齐泣下。

en.t: The Dazai no Daini and all the people who had come there to welcome him heard what he said, felt deeply sorry, and wept together.

units.source_text: 那五节小姐多方设法，派人送了一封信去：

en.t: That young lady of the Gosechi dances tried every possible means and sent someone to deliver a letter:
